question: Approve the corrected DEV-12 Pilot shape to enter implementation?

artifacts.summary: Cycle 4 defines one read-only workspace-bound Linear admission command and an explicit admission-only canonical Development Brief guard. New admissions require one Acceptance criteria section with stable AC-N identifiers and reject evidence-only or dual-section input; normal profile loading remains unchanged, so already-admitted work is neither revalidated nor migrated. The authoritative 60-second measurement includes the fresh Linear read. AC-1 through AC-6 are covered. The integrated Draft PR is estimated at fourteen files and about 1,350 changed lines, with hard stops at 15 files, 1,501 changed lines, or 121 loader lines; most volume is deterministic tests, package/adopter parity, and retained-document alignment. No sync, webhook, automatic launch, paid delegation, multi-issue package, Initiative, Milestone, POC redesign, or prior-work migration is included.
